promise: Master times tables through magical adventures.
map_title: A little math. A lot of magic.
map_story: Help Pip bring the island crystals back to life. Choose a place to explore.
map_description: Four magical islands connected by a golden trail. Pip the friendly dragon waits to explore.
unlock_explanation: Each completed mission restores a crystal. The next islands open at 2, 4 and 6 crystals with the full adventure. You can always practice every times table for free in the meadow.
development: Development build · all six modes available for testing
island_story_0: Mossy's crystal has lost its sparkle. Help Pip gather five sparks and wake the great tree.
island_story_1: The Sunstone bridge is asleep. Restore its lanterns to help the desert creatures cross.
island_story_2: The moon mushrooms need a little light. Collect sparks to illuminate the grove.
island_story_3: The observatory has gone quiet. Bring the stars back to the mountain sky.
battle_description: Cast friendly number spells to help a muddled monster.
treasure_description: Choose the numbered locks and uncover five treasures.
jump_description: Find the correct number platform and cross the stepping stones.
race_description: Power your little racer, at your own pace or with a stopwatch.
kitchen_description: Add equal scoops, count your ingredients and serve a recipe.
robot_description: Solve circuits to assemble your own colorful companion.
battle_scene: Pip faces a friendly purple monster. Each correct answer casts a golden spark.
treasure_scene: Five wooden chests. Completed locks reveal golden treasure.
jump_scene: Pip crosses stepping stone platforms after each correct answer.
race_scene: A little teal racing car advances towards a chequered flag.
kitchen_scene: Five bowls on a kitchen bench await equal portions of ingredients.
robot_scene: A robot gains arms and legs as circuits are completed.
mission_intro_0: Let's help Mossy. Solve five number spells to restore the crystal.
mission_intro_1: Let's look for treasure. Solve the number locks to open the chests.
mission_intro_2: Let's cross the stepping stones. Choose the correct answer platform.
mission_intro_3: Ready to explore the track? Each answer powers your car.
mission_intro_4: Welcome to the kitchen. Add equal scoops to make your recipe.
mission_intro_5: Let's build a robot. Solve each circuit to add a new part.
task_0: Choose a number spell to send a friendly spark.
task_1: Which numbered lock opens the next treasure chest?
task_2: Choose the answer platform for Pip's next jump.
task_3: Choose the answer to power the next stretch of track.
task_4: The first number is scoops. The second is ingredients per scoop. Add equal scoops, then serve.
task_5: Choose the matching circuit to attach the next robot part.
premium_parent: Ask a grown-up about the full adventure in the parent area. You can keep learning in the meadow.
push_talk: Tap to speak · tap again to stop
timer_note: Your answer time appears after each correct answer. There is no time limit or penalty.
correct: Lovely thinking! Another spark of magic.
complete_story: Pip and the island creatures thank you. Your crystal is restored. Come back whenever you would like another adventure.
pause_message: Your adventure is saved. There is no hurry.
parent_gate_help: Please ask a grown-up to solve this before opening settings and purchases.
gate_error: Please ask a grown-up to help.
progress_explanation: Accuracy uses the first answer to each question. A fact is marked mastered after three consecutive correct answers without hints. This is a practice indicator, not an educational assessment.
voice_disclosure: Voice is off by default. This build uses Android's on-device recognition only (Android 12 or later with an installed service and language). Tap the microphone button to speak; tap again to stop. Listening also stops after one utterance or eight seconds. TimesQuest does not record, save or upload audio. Availability varies by device. A parent gate is not legal verification of parental consent. Touch controls always work.
voice_available: An on-device service is detected. The installed language still needs a successful device test.
voice_unavailable: On-device voice answering is unavailable here. Please use the answer buttons. Check microphone permission in Android settings if needed.
voice_error: I couldn't understand that. Please try again or tap an answer.
tts_unavailable: No installed offline narration voice is available. Please use the written question.
premium_details: All four islands, six mission types and companion colors. Every times table remains available in free practice. No advertisements or subscriptions.
owned: Full adventure owned on this Amazon account
one_time: One-time purchase through Amazon. Confirm the local price in the store sheet.
restore_requested: Restore requested. A compatible Amazon store and signed-in account are required.
privacy_detail: No child accounts, advertising, analytics, chat or social features. Learning records, settings and mission progress stay in this app's private device storage. Android backup is disabled. The Amazon build contacts Amazon for store prices, account and purchase receipts. Speech uses an installed offline voice or on-device recognition only. Delete learning records here; uninstall to remove all app data. Purchases remain with your store account. This is a development build; the publisher's final privacy policy and contact details must be supplied before release.
delete_confirm: This permanently deletes local answers, mastery, badges and mission progress. Purchase ownership is preserved. This cannot be undone.
math_added_factors: That adds the two numbers. Multiplication means equal groups.
math_one_group: You may have counted one group too many or too few. Count by {b}: {count}.
parent_locked_help: Settings and purchases lock when you leave the app or after two minutes. Your learning progress stays saved.
revision_suggestion: Try the {table} times table next. This suggestion uses practice records on this device.
table_details: {facts} facts tried · {hints} first answers with hints · {due} facts due for review
table_time: Average first-answer time: {seconds} seconds. Hints and thinking time are included; there is no speed target.
language_help: UK English is the default. US English is a development preview pending review. Other languages will appear only after review and validation.
voice_no_offline_narrator: An offline narration voice is not ready. Please use the written question.
tts_initializing: The narrator is getting ready. The written question is ready now.
store_missing_key: Amazon purchasing is not configured in this build.
store_unavailable: The store is unavailable. Free learning is ready to play.
store_restore_failed: Could not check purchase history. Try again when Amazon is available.
purchase_cancelled: The purchase was cancelled. Nothing was unlocked.
purchase_failed: The purchase did not complete. You can try again in the parent area.
purchase_pending: The store has not confirmed this purchase yet.
save_recovered: A saved mission could not be restored. Your valid learning records are still available.
